sections.heading: Business and Location of Risk
sections.body: Trading, storage and dispatch of TMT bars, structural steel, MS plates, HR/CR coils and allied steel products, including loading and unloading by overhead cranes and forklifts at the insured premises. Location of risk: godown and yard at Siltara Industrial Growth Centre, Phase II, Raipur, Chhattisgarh. Total turnover declared for rating: as per proposal form dated 10/06/2025.

sections.heading: Operative Clause
sections.body: Subject to the terms, exclusions and conditions of this Policy, the Company will indemnify the Insured against legal liability to pay compensation, together with claimant's costs and expenses, in respect of accidental death or bodily injury to any third party and accidental loss of or damage to third-party property, arising out of the insured business at the location of risk and occurring during the period of insurance. Defence costs incurred with the prior written consent of the Company are payable within and not in addition to the limits of indemnity.

sections.heading: Principal Exclusions
sections.body: Liability under any workmen's compensation or employees' state insurance legislation; liability assumed by agreement unless such liability would have attached in the absence of such agreement; pollution or contamination other than sudden, unintended and unexpected events; products liability for goods after they have left the custody of the Insured; fines, penalties, punitive or exemplary damages; war, nuclear risks and terrorism; and loss of or damage to property belonging to or in the care, custody or control of the Insured.

sections.heading: Conditions and Claims Procedure
sections.body: The Insured shall give immediate written notice to the Company of any occurrence likely to give rise to a claim and shall forward every letter, claim, summons or legal process unanswered. No admission, offer, promise or payment shall be made without the written consent of the Company. Claims may be intimated at the Raipur servicing office or on the Company's toll-free number 1800-209-4417. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Indian courts and the Insurance Ombudsman as per the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.

sections.heading: Important Notes
sections.body: This schedule is issued on the basis of the proposal and declaration signed by the Insured, which form the basis of this contract. Stamp duty of Rs. 1/- paid by consolidated method vide order of the competent authority. Please verify the details printed in this schedule and report any discrepancy within 15 days of receipt. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. For grievances write to grievance.raipur@vindhyaassurance.example.in.
